svg.title: Two cross-sections of the wafer, one above the other. Before the step a thin resist film covers everything but the left-hand active area, where a doped layer lies in the silicon. After it the resist is gone and the rest of the drawing is unchanged.
svg.desc: Two cross-sections of the wafer, one above the other. Before the step a thin resist film covers everything but the left-hand active area, where a doped layer lies in the silicon. After it the resist is gone and the rest of the drawing is unchanged.
svg.text: Before: the thin HVNTM resist after HVASTI (step 069)
The thin implanted resist is ashed and
the wafer cleaned, sparing the oxide.
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
